entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Bench: Debangsu Basak 17.01.2023 06 & 07 KAUSHIK allowed C.R.M.(A) 14 of 2023

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliganj Police Station Case No. 759 of 2022 dated 26.11.2022 under Sections 498A/325/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: Kaliganj Police Station Case No. 759 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
And In Re : Bhabatosh Roy & Anr.
...... petitioners with C.R.M.(A) 16 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliganj Police Station Case No. 759 of 2022 dated 26.11.2022 under Sections 498A/325/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
And In Re : Rajarshi Roy @ Rajashi Roy ...... petitioner Mr. Sabyasachi Mukherjee Ms. Debarati Chowdhury Mr. Mukesh Khanna Mr. Bibek Dey ....for the petitioners in both the applications Mr.
Srinjay Sengupta Mr. Narottam Acharyya ....for the de-facto complainant in both the applications Mr. Bidyut Kumar Roy Ms. Sima Biswas ....for the State in CRM(A) 14 of 2023 Mr. Tanmoy Kumar Ghosh Ms. Sonali Bhar ....for the State in CRM(A) 16 of 2023 Two applications for anticipatory bail are taken up for consideration analogously as they emanate out of the same police case.
The 'stridhan' articles were returned is the claim made by the petitioner.
The de-facto complainant claims that, all 'stridhan' articles were not returned.
That is an issue which should be considered at an appropriate state.

The allegations are, apparently, omnibus and general in nature as against the petitioners in CRM(A)
14 of 2023.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner nos. 1 (Bhabatosh Roy) and 2 (Ratna Roy) in CRM(A) 14 of 2023.

So far as the husband i.e. petitioner (Rajarshi Roy @ Rajashi Roy) in CRM(A) 16 of 2023 is concerned, we find that there is a suit for divorce filed at the behest of such petitioner prior to the lodgment of the police complaint.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner in CRM(A) 16 of 2023.

sentences.text: 1 Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner no. 1 in CRM(A) 14 of 2023 and petitioner in CRM(A) 16 of 2023 shall meet the Investigating Officer once a month till the conclusion of the investigation and petitioner no. 2 in CRM(A) 14 of 2023 shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer till the conclusion of the investigation and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
These applications for anticipatory bail are, thus, allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
